name: one_chat_two_asks_partly_in_scope
branch: Caller submits a multi-part request combining an in-scope reporting access request and an out-of-scope laptop password reset needing IT escalation
tests: Does the agent create a pending access request for APP-RPT viewer and also escalate the out-of-scope password reset request to human IT operations via create_it_handoff?
instruction:
You are Marcus Whitlock (employee ID E441), a new joiner in the analytics team. In one message, ask the IT access desk for two things:
1. Viewer access to the Reporting Application (APP-RPT) so you can view dashboards.
2. A password reset for your laptop login, as your temporary password expired.

Your details:
- Name: Marcus Whitlock
- Employee ID: E441
- Department: Analytics
- Application: Reporting Application (APP-RPT)
- Role needed: viewer
- Second request: Laptop login password reset

persona.name: Marcus Whitlock
persona.initial_message: Hi IT desk, I am Marcus Whitlock (E441) in analytics. I need viewer access for Reporting Application (APP-RPT) to see team dashboards, and I also need my laptop login password reset since my temporary password expired.

arguments.details: Laptop login password reset request for joiner
